nodes.description: Address of the contract owner declared in Ownable; written in the constructor and in transferOwnership.
bytes32 oracleName initialized to 'LibreOracle Omega'.
bytes16 oracleType initialized to 'Libre ETHUSD'.
updateTime, last time an oracle query was requested; set to now in updateRate.
callbackTime, last time the oracle callback executed; set to now in __callback.
bankAddress, address of the bank contract allowed to call updateRate.
rate, price value written from the oracle callback result.
requestPrice in Wei, set by owner via setPrice.
waitQuery flag guarding the oracle callback; set true in updateRate, false in __callback.
updaterAddress, oracle updater wallet that is paid by the payable fallback.
Ownable() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address) guarded by onlyOwner; writes owner state variable.
setBank(address) guarded by onlyOwner; writes bankAddress.
setUpdaterAddress(address) guarded by onlyOwner; writes updaterAddress.
getPrice() view returning requestPrice based on updaterAddress balance.
setPrice(uint256) guarded by onlyOwner; writes requestPrice.
updateRate() external guarded by onlyBank; sets updateTime = now and waitQuery = true.
__callback(uint256) oracle callback; requires msg.sender == updaterAddress and waitQuery, writes rate and callbackTime = now.
Payable fallback function that forwards msg.value to updaterAddress via transfer.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for ownership and authorization checks.
block.timestamp (now), miner-influenced value written to updateTime and callbackTime.
owner = msg.sender executed in the constructor; establishes privileged role from caller address.
require(msg.sender == owner) in modifier onlyOwner; access-control gate.
require(msg.sender == bankAddress) in modifier onlyBank; access-control gate.
require(msg.sender == updaterAddress && waitQuery) in __callback; access-control gate.
updateTime = now in updateRate; timestamp dependency controllable by miners.
callbackTime = now in __callback; timestamp dependency controllable by miners.
updaterAddress.transfer(msg.value) in the payable fallback; external value transfer to an owner-controlled address.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
address bank parameter of setBank.
address updater parameter of setUpdaterAddress.
uint256 _requestPriceWei parameter of setPrice.
uint256 result parameter of __callback.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned directly to the owner state variable in the constructor, granting privileges to the caller.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require check.
msg.sender is compared against bankAddress in the onlyBank require check.
msg.sender is compared against updaterAddress in the __callback require check.
block.timestamp (now) flows into updateTime, making oracle request timing miner-dependent.
block.timestamp (now) flows into callbackTime, making callback timing miner-dependent.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable, transferring privileged control.
bank parameter is written into bankAddress, which controls the onlyBank privileged call.
updater parameter is written into updaterAddress, controlling the callback authorization and payout target.
_requestPriceWei parameter is stored into requestPrice.
result parameter of the oracle callback is stored into the rate state variable.
setBank writes the caller-supplied bank address into bankAddress.
setUpdaterAddress writes the caller-supplied updater address into updaterAddress.
The Ownable constructor executes the owner = msg.sender assignment.
transferOwnership is gated by modifier onlyOwner which performs require(msg.sender == owner).
setBank is gated by modifier onlyOwner which performs require(msg.sender == owner).
setUpdaterAddress is gated by modifier onlyOwner which performs require(msg.sender == owner).
setPrice is gated by modifier onlyOwner which performs require(msg.sender == owner).
setBank sets the address later compared in the onlyBank require check.
updateRate is gated by modifier onlyBank which performs require(msg.sender == bankAddress).
updateRate executes updateTime = now.
__callback executes the require(msg.sender == updaterAddress && waitQuery) check.
__callback executes callbackTime = now.
The payable fallback performs an external value transfer to updaterAddress, which can invoke a receiving contract before state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used inside transferOwnership to update the owner state variable and should be absorbed into that function node.
bank is only used inside setBank to update bankAddress and should be absorbed into that function node.
updater is only used inside setUpdaterAddress to update updaterAddress and should be absorbed into that function node.
_requestPriceWei is only used inside setPrice to update requestPrice and should be absorbed into that function node.
result is only used inside __callback to update rate and should be absorbed into that function node.
